text:
jordan: Heads up 10 Jun move question. Planning to work from Vancouver BC for ~3 months (June 15 -> Sep 15) while partner finishes a project. A few quick Qs: will my WFH stipend continue/need proration, does our US health plan cover me in Canada, do I need to change payroll or will we keep US withholding, and any immigration/payroll red flags? Dont want surprises on pay or benefits. cc @kim-people-ops

kim-people-ops: Congrats! Short version: update Homebase as soon as date is firm, we need to review international work policy. For short trips we often allow continued US payroll but there are tax and local employment considerations > 30 days. We'll triage with payroll + legal.

ada-payroll: Hi Jordan  payroll notes: 1) If you remain an employee on US payroll while working in Canada, we may need a cross-border payroll setup or apply tax treaties. 2) If you will be physically present > 30 days in Canada we generally consult tax counsel and may require local payroll/withholding or special forms. 3) Payroll cutoff to request any tax-withholding or payroll-mode changes for the mid-June pay is 2026-06-01 23:59 PT. Please use: https://redwood.internal/payroll/international-move to start the intake.

jordan: Ok, thanks. Im planning 2026-06-15 to 2026-09-15. Im UK/US dual citizen so no work-visa worries, but want to avoid double taxation and keep health coverage if possible. Also, can I keep stipend while abroad?

tess-benefits: Benefits team: our core medical plans are US-based networks and typically do not cover routine care in Canada (emergency care may be covered). Options: 1) short-term international travel rider (if available on your plan), 2) enroll in private Canadian coverage if you switch payroll to Canadian provider, or 3) pay out-of-pocket and submit claims on return if plan permits. Send DM with plan name and provider you use and well check quickly. WFH stipend: policy ties stipend to homebase; temporary international remote work can continue but is treated case-by-case and may be paused if you switch payroll or benefits.

kim-people-ops: WFH stipend/proration rules: moving mid-month -> prorated. For temporary relocation, if payroll and benefits remain US-based we can often continue stipend for the full month if Homebase remains your US city. If you want us to prorate for the June partial month, reply: PRORATE 2026-06-15. If you prefer to preserve stipend for the full month while abroad reply: KEEP 2026-06. We will need manager approval for exceptions.

ada-payroll: Action items from payroll/next steps:
- jordan: submit international-move intake form by 2026-06-01 if you want payroll/tax handling for June.
- payroll: schedule consult with tax counsel if physical presence > 30 days.
- kim-people-ops: confirm whether Redwood will treat this as temporary remote work or international assignment.

people-ops-bot: Summary actions (ticket created #INTL-654):
- jordan: update Homebase and submit proof of travel/address by 2026-06-01.
- jordan: reply with PRORATE 2026-06-15 OR KEEP 2026-06.
- tess-benefits: verify plan-specific international coverage and options.
- ada-payroll: queue tax counsel consult and confirm cutoff handling.

jordan: Thanks  I'll submit form today and DM Tess my PCP + plan name. Ill reply PRORATE 2026-06-15 since Ill only be there half a month. Also please flag any visa/payroll docs I should prepare (I have passport copies).

tess-benefits: Got it  DM received. Quick follow-up: your plan is an HMO in WA? If yes, in-network coverage definitely differs. We'll check travel rider and whether claims can be reimbursed.

ada-payroll: Noted PRORATE. We'll check cutoff and confirm whether June pay will show the prorate or require a retro adjustment. If tax counsel is needed we will reach out with a short questionnaire on ties: property, bank accounts, filing status.

kim-people-ops: Thanks all. We'll follow up on ticket #INTL-654 with clear approvals and timeline. Jordan  ping us if plans change. :airplane:
